If you still want to use it, please treat it as unmaintained"},{"id":"p4s6","text":" software and check it against your dsh version before relying on it."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Session notifications + an in-conversation ladder outline for the **DeepSeek Harness Web GUI (dsh we"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"b)**. Get notified when the AI finishes replying, asks you a question, or needs command approval — e"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"ven while the tab is away — and navigate past questions via a compact outline rail."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Built independently with dsh + Deepseek-V4-Flash"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"### Session notifications
- **Three trigger kinds**, each independently switchable:
- `reply`: the A"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"I finished replying
- `ask`: the AI explicitly asks you a question (ask-user tool) — a plain finishe"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"d reply does NOT re-fire
- `confirm`: a command approval is pending (approval dialog)
- A reply noti"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"fies when you were **away at any point during that turn**; stays silent while you watch it
- **Host-"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"driven + cross-tab**: triggers come from the session event log (reply on a completed turn, ask on th"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"e ask-user tool, confirm on an approval request) relayed over SSE to every open tab, and each event "},{"id":"p8s7","text":"pops **at most one OS toast** — a notified ledger claims it once across tabs and reloads; DOM observ"},{"id":"p8s8","text":"ation is the fallback while the stream is down
- **Native OS toast** (Windows PowerShell WinRT / mac"},{"id":"p8s9","text":"OS osascript / Linux notify-send) — no browser permission, not suppressed by Chrome — plus a red-dot"},{"id":"p8s10","text":" favicon & `(●)` title badge, and an optional sound
- Title is "workspace · session title"; one noti"},{"id":"p8s11","text":"itle badge, and an optional sound
- Title is "workspace · session title"; one notification per reply"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"### Ladder outline
- A collapsible rail on the right side listing every **user question** in order
-"},{"id":"p9s2","text":" Thin rounded bars when idle (no text, no crowding), even with dozens/hundreds of turns
- Hover a ru"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"ng for a floating tooltip (number + question summary + time); click to scroll to that turn with a fl"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"ash highlight
- Scrollspy highlights the current turn; a jump-to-latest button appears when you are "},{"id":"p9s5","text":"not at the bottom
- Older history is paged in on demand via the "`+older`" footer
- Hidden automatic"},{"id":"p9s6","text":"ally when the session has fewer than two turns
- The rail **anchors to the conversation's right edge"},{"id":"p9s7","text":" and follows it** whenever a sidebar expands/shrinks the conversation (event-driven, zero idle cost)"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"### In-app upgrades
- The settings card shows the current version and can check the npm registry for"},{"id":"p10s2","text":" the latest release
- One-click upgrade through the official `dsh plugin add` CLI (restart dsh web t"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"est release
- One-click upgrade through the official `dsh plugin add` CLI (restart dsh web to apply)"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"### Session cleanup
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| Layer | Implementation |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"| Notifications | Host watches the session event log and relays reply/ask/confirm triggers over SSE "},{"id":"p14s2","text":"(`/api/session-buddy/events`) to every tab; a notified ledger claimed at the loopback-only `/api/ses"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"sion-buddy/toast` route dedupes across tabs and reloads (one OS toast per event). Client-side DOM ob"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"servation (`MutationObserver` + official anchors + the composer stop-button running signal) is the f"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"allback while the stream is down |
| Outline | Rungs come from the official `sessions` service snaps"},{"id":"p14s6","text":"hot (independent of how much DOM is rendered); dsh conversation history is a paged window, so the ou"},{"id":"p14s7","text":"tline pages hidden history in on demand and aligns rungs to the DOM via the official anchor keys |
|"},{"id":"p14s8","text":" Upgrades | The host reads `https://registry.npmjs.org/dsh-session-buddy/latest` (fail-closed when o"},{"id":"p14s9","text":"ffline) and runs the official `dsh plugin` CLI for the actual upgrade |
| Session cleanup | The host"},{"id":"p14s10","text":" lists sessions via `sessionPersistence`, flags corruption by replicating the harness's own load-tim"},{"id":"p14s11","text":"e message validation, and deletes a session's directory (resolved through the persistence service's "},{"id":"p14s12","text":"`locate()`, never from user input); the browser marks corrupt rows and injects the delete item into "},{"id":"p14s13","text":"the row menu |
| Tool-run collapsing | Pure client DOM pass over the official anchor rows: `tool-cal"},{"id":"p14s14","text":"l` rows are grouped by their enclosing `turn-tail` row (the tail is only published after `turn/end`,"},{"id":"p14s15","text":" so folding happens exactly when the turn is finished), each group collapses to a "共执行 X 步操作" chip w"},{"id":"p14s16","text":"ith per-session expand state |
| Transcript folding | The same official-markers pass groups a turn's"},{"id":"p14s17","text":" `assistant-step` rows (think blocks + text "小结" + context injections) by its `turn-tail` row into a"},{"id":"p14s18","text":" "共 N 次思考" chip, leaving the final summary visible; over-long `user` rows are clamped to 6 lines wit"},{"id":"p14s19","text":"h an expand bar. Both silently degrade if the official markers vanish |
| Outline positioning | The "},{"id":"p14s20","text":"rail re-reads the conversation scrollport's right edge on resize, on container/ancestor resize, and "},{"id":"p14s21","text":"on DOM mutations (coalesced to one pass per frame), so it always moves with the conversation width |"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Limitations"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"- Native toasts depend on the OS notification settings; the favicon/title badge always works as a pa"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"rallel cue
- The "one OS toast per event" dedup applies to the host-driven stream; while that stream"},{"id":"p17s3","text":" is down (older host, or a connection failure) the DOM fallback notifies per tab, so several hidden "},{"id":"p17s4","text":"tabs could each pop a toast for the same event
- Session deletion is **permanent** (no recycle bin);"},{"id":"p17s5","text":" the "删除会话" item is only injected into the session menu while the menu DOM is recognizable, and degr"},{"id":"p17s6","text":"ades silently otherwise
- All folding surfaces rely on the official `data-chat-flow-kind` / `data-ch"},{"id":"p17s7","text":"at-anchor-key` markers (question clamping additionally on the `_text_` class); if a future dsh versi"},{"id":"p17s8","text":"on drops them, the plugin silently stops folding (it never hides rows it cannot confidently attribut"},{"id":"p17s9","text":"e to a finished turn)
- An upgrade takes effect only after restarting `dsh web`"}],"truncated":true}
